t: You're standing on Lansdowne Crescent, a curving street in Notting Hill, in the W11 postcode. It runs west off Ladbroke Grove. The name comes from Henry Petty-Fitzmaurice, the 3rd Marquess of Lansdowne. He was a Whig statesman whose ministerial career lasted nearly half a century. He served as Home Secretary and as Chancellor of the Exchequer, and three times as Lord President of the Council. He sat in every Whig or Liberal ministry from 1806 to 1863. So the street carries the name of one of the longest-serving politicians of his age.
